output.reason: On its own, the cited bullet [ev-0872dba545cc] is just a metric name. The section it sits in [ev-1f419676f177] says what changes for every metric in that list. In Loki 3.0.0, metrics that started with `cortex_` will start with `loki_` instead, so this one becomes `loki_prometheus_notifications_queue_capacity`. Environments whose `metrics_namespace` is the default `loki` are exposed, and setting it to `cortex` keeps the old prefix. That setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. If the operator does nothing, the metric appears only under the new `loki_` name, so anything that queries the `cortex_` name stops matching.
